title: Ruins Left Behind
physical_identity: Collapsed multi-storey car park, formerly the micronation Emstable; rubble, girders, rusted car husks, abandoned tents with corpses, deep mining holes.
scale_topology: Described as an infinite car park; indoor multi-floor with stratified floors (census to Floor 28); large parts inaccessible after collapse.
anomalies: new exits formed by collapse (holes to Level 21 and 23)
noclip through cars or debris to Level 817
hazards: unstable structure and tripping on rubble/rebar
items_communities: recovered diary 'Hilda' and census report held by Kalag Institute/M.E.G./B.N.T.G.
top floor had Wi-Fi, pool, football table, electric cookers

verticality: Strong: multiple collapsed decks and deep holes, climbing risky.
